# 条件的对应纪律：只有交互才经由条件相关，惰性条件不再免费连通，连通由活的使用造成 / A correspondence discipline for conditions: only interaction relates through a condition, idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection is made by living use

## 主张 Claim

在依存网的逐步读法上，保留 living（活跃且不侵蚀），把 related 从共同参与收窄为交互：两个事件经由某条件相关，仅当一方汲取它、另一方以正水平依存于它，在任何步上（不排定时间，也不问汲取是否改变水平）。没有活动汲取、或没有依存能落空的条件是惰性的：它不构成任何关系，也不使任何事件侵蚀；加入它不改变 living、关系与连通。于是独立审查 Q4 的免费连通被排除：加入人人在水平 0 依存、无人汲取的条件，在共同参与下使每个网连通，在交互下连通不变。每个侵蚀关系都是交互；在 N_rel 下，珍视一个侵蚀事件的立场，必珍视被侵蚀形成在以正水平依存于该条件的每一步上的活的事件。传递由汲取承担，不由侵蚀承担：珍视任何汲取事件的立场，必珍视以正水平依存于该条件的每个活的事件（drawing_reaches），所以审查 Q5 只有共同依存的一半被排除。一个条件，每个活的事件都汲取它或以正水平依存于它，且有活的汲取者与活的依存者，使整体连通，任意两个活的事件至多经两次交互相连；于是 G0 在那里恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std。在一个例子中，两个依存于同一条件的形成，经由维持其支持的使用连通；唯一的使用侵蚀它们时不连通；共同参与在两次运行中都连通它们。加入一个被更新、人人以正水平依存的条件，只要一个活的事件汲取它一次，仍使每个网在交互下连通而不改变 living（one_use_connects）；不需要人人汲取。不用 Lean 公理，不加伦理谓词。 / On the stepwise reading of a web, keep living (active and not undermining) and narrow related from co-participation to interaction: two events are related through a condition only when one draws on it and the other depends on it at a positive level, at any steps (neither order in time nor change of level enters). A condition that no activity draws on, or no dependence on which can fail, is idle: it relates nothing and undermines nothing, and adjoining one leaves living, the relation and connection unchanged. So the free connection of the independent review's Q4 is excluded: adjoining a condition every formation requires at level zero and nothing draws on connects every web under co-participation and leaves connection unchanged under interaction. Every undermining relation is an interaction; under N_rel, a standpoint valuing an undermining event holds significant the living events of the formation it undermines at every step where that formation depends on the condition at a positive level. The transmission is carried by drawing, not undermining: a standpoint valuing any drawing event holds significant every living event depending on the condition at a positive level (drawing_reaches), so only the co-dependence half of review Q5 is excluded. A condition that every living event draws on or depends on at a positive level, with a living drawer and a living dependent, connects the whole, any two living events being linked in at most two interactions; G0 there is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std. In one example two formations depending on one condition are connected through a use that keeps their support, and not when the only use undermines it, while co-participation connects them in both runs. Adjoining a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by one living event, still connects every web under interaction without changing living (one_use_connects); every formation drawing on it is not needed. No Lean axiom is used and no ethical predicate is added.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 依存网与逐步读法如 becoming-stepwise-reading 所设；draws 不带数量；交互像共同参与一样，不排定两个事件的时间次序，也不问汲取是否改变水平（Later、Pinned.drawing_interacts）。 / The web and the stepwise reading are those of becoming-stepwise-reading; draws carries no amount; like co-participation, interaction does not order the two events in time, and it does not ask whether the drawing changes the level (Later, Pinned.drawing_interacts).
- 连通的结论需要一个每个活的事件都承担于其上的条件，并有活的汲取者与活的依存者；刻画结论还需要至少一个活的事件；传递结论需要 N_rel，其规范地位不由本结果证明。 / The connection result needs a condition on which every living event bears, with a living drawer and a living dependent; the characterization also needs some living event; the transmission result needs N_rel, whose normative standing this result does not prove.

纪律是公开的对应选择，不是展开的推论。交互是结构上的共现：一方汲取、另一方以正水平依存于同一个能使之落空的条件，在任何步上；它还不是“一方的汲取落在另一方的支持上”，那需要排定时间、对效果敏感的版本，开放。共同依存，即两个形成依存于同一条件，是纪律所省略的关系（经由共同条件的共同构成），不是没有关系；Shared 显示省略它的代价，应用若要把它算作关系，须写出它。纪律排除的是结构上不能承载交互的条件，不是虚假的汲取或依存声明：一个被更新、人人以正水平依存、被一个活的事件使用一次的条件，在网上与真实的共同条件（例如人人呼吸的空气）无法区分，它给出的连通是一个须由应用检验的事实主张。共同参与这一选择及其后果（Q4）仍保留在核心上；选择哪一种由 Ren 决定。 / The discipline is a disclosed correspondence choice, not a consequence of the unfolding. Interaction is a structural coincidence: one draws on, and the other depends at a positive level on, one condition that can fail it, at any steps. It is not yet one formation's drawing bearing on another's support; that needs an ordered, effect-sensitive version, which is open. Co-dependence, two formations depending on one condition, is a relation the discipline omits (co-constitution through a common condition), not an absence of relation; Shared exhibits the cost of omitting it, and an application that counts it must write it out. The discipline excludes conditions that structurally cannot carry interaction, not false claims of drawing or dependence: a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by a living event, is indistinguishable on the web from a genuine common condition (say, the air everyone breathes), and the connection it gives is a factual claim that application must check. The co-participation choice and its consequence (Q4) remain on the core; which to adopt is Ren's decision.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

排定时间、对效果敏感的交互（汲取不晚于依存，且水平随汲取而异）及其连通类，它会抬高剩余免费连通的价格；对整段读法陈述同一关系；在关系层读法上排除惰性条件（审查指出关系层的 related 同样可被免费连通）；Ren 在共同参与与交互之间的选择。 / An ordered, effect-sensitive interaction (drawing no later than the dependence, with a level that differs with the draw) and its connected class, which would raise the price of the residual free connection; the same relation for the whole-run reading; excluding idle conditions at the relation level (review notes the relation-level related can also be connected for free); Ren's choice between co-participation and interaction.
